---
description: "Turn a user story into approved, testable functional and non-functional requirements"
name: "SDLC 1 — Requirements"
agent: "Requirements Agent"
argument-hint: "Paste the user story or point to its source"
model: "Claude Haiku 4.5 (copilot)"
---

Follow [the requirements skill](../skills/requirements/SKILL.md). Clarify the supplied user story before drafting; ask focused questions where assumptions change behavior.

Create or update `requirements.md` with:
- User story, source, and business problem
- Functional and non-functional requirements
- Testable, traceable acceptance criteria
- Confirmed assumptions, open questions, and out-of-scope items

Do not invent answers or proceed to architecture. Summarize the draft and request human approval.
